- `lib/request.js:318`, in the `protocol` getter: `this.get('X-Forwarded-Proto')`
- `lib/request.js:429` and `:432`, in the `hostname` getter: `this.get('X-Forwarded-Host')` and `this.get('Host')`
- `lib/request.js:507`, in the `xhr` getter: `this.get('X-Requested-With')`
- `lib/response.js:912`, in `res.location`: `this.req.get('Referrer')`

I left out the other `this.get(...)` calls in `lib/response.js`, because there `this` is the response, so they are `res.get`. I also left out every `this.app.get(...)` and `app.get(...)` call.
